messages:
laura: Quick ping — PR #4892 tiny naming + fmt cleanup. Need one more approval to merge before today's snapshot cut. PTAL when you get a sec.

mike: on it, will review now.

srinivas: quick q — is this just renames/format? any behavioral changes I should look for?

laura: only renames + comment tweaks. Ran `gofumpt` and `staticcheck` locally; left a short note in the PR about the rationale for the rename. No logic change.

mike: looks straightforward. small nit: `cacheKey` -> `cacheID` is fine but update the comment on Set/Get to mention it's a stable identifier.

srinivas: small bikeshed: "Key" vs "ID". We usually use "ID" for numeric identifiers. Are these human-friendly keys or opaque IDs?

laura: opaque, stable string (derived from userID+version). We use "ID" elsewhere for opaque tokens, so leaning to `cacheID` for consistency. happy to change if you prefer otherwise.

mike: SGTM for `cacheID`. Also CI will fail if gofumpt wasn't applied — can you run `gofumpt -w` and push the fmt changes?

ci-bot: CI: fmt check FAILED for PR #4892. See https://ci.redwood.example/builds/4892/format.

laura: pushed fmt + comment updates at commit 123abc (pushed 6478901350). Ran `gofumpt -w` and `staticcheck` locally.

eva: quick glance: LGTM :thumbsup: one docstring nit but not blocking.

mike: left one inline nit about a comment wording, otherwise approved.

srinivas: approved after seeing the updated comments and run of linters.

laura: thanks all — I'll merge during the 10:00 merge window unless someone flags. Adding a short entry to the changelog.

deploy-bot: Merge queued for PR #4892 — scheduled to merge at 2026-03-18T10:05:00Z if no new CI failures.

laura: merged — thanks! :tada: :coffee:
